subdivision_of_building: There are no existing buildings on the site
description: Erection of four temporary tents in the Walled Garden and temporary bunk wagons and caravans in the Cherry Orchard for staff accommodation, public toilets and showers for staff and a bar wagon to facilitate a temporary circus and set up from 3rd June to 24th June 2024 and for three weeks each year up to 2028
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted is restricted to 3rd June to 24th June 2024 and for three weeks each year up to 2028. The temporary structures shall only be used by members of the public between the dates of 6th June to 23th June 2024 (inclusive but excluding 11th, 12th, 18th and 19th June 2024) and for three weeks each year up to 2028. The site shall be closed to members of the public between the hours of 23:30 and 10:00 during this time. 

Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties and to protect the openness and historic character of the site; in accordance with Local Plan policies EQ5, GB1, CC1, CC2 and CC4. 

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [4548C-100-A, 4548C-101-A, 4548C-102-A, 4548C-103-A, Unnumbered floor plan, Unnumbered plan related to parking, Planning Statement, Noise Impact Assessment, Map of Chiswick House, Tree map, Fire Safety Statement, Letter from Chiswick House dated 19 January 2024, Unnumbered photograph. Received: 16/2/2024 
4548C-2-100-A, 4548C-2-101-A, 4548C-2-102-A and unnumbered plan related to ristorante. Received: 27/3/2024 
Traffic Assessment. Received: 26/4/2024].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - No playing of musical instruments or operation of sound amplification equipment in association with the development hereby permitted shall take place outside of the hours of 09:00 and 23:00. 

Reason: To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of nearby occupiers or the area generally; in accordance with Local Plan policy EQ5. 
Condition : 4 - The music or public address system noise levels in association with the development hereby permitted, when measured or predicted at 1m from the fa�ade of noise sensitive premises, shall not exceed 65dB(a) over a 15 minute period.

Reason: To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of nearby occupiers or the area generally; in accordance with Local Plan policy EQ5. 
Condition : 5 - The measures in the Traffic Assessment received on 26/4/2024 shall at all times be implemented as approved.

Reason: To promote walking, cycling and the use of public transport, and to limit the impact of customer parking on surrounding streets, in accordance with Local Plan policy EC2.
Condition : 6 - The event website shall provide a link to Transport for London's 'Plan a journey' webpage, and all tickets (electronic or paper form) shall be accompanied by the map of the site which outlines various public transport routes to and from the site.

Reason: To promote walking, cycling and the use of public transport in accordance with Local Plan policy EC2.
Condition : 7 - The on-site public car parking area shall be actively monitored and controlled prior to and after each showing to ensure that spaces are used efficiently and to prevent queueing on the A4 to enter the car park. The Council shall be notified of any complaints made to the applicant regarding parking on the site or on surrounding streets and will remedy these, or any other traffic or parking problems associated with the development that transpire, to the satisfaction of the Council.

Reason: In the interests of the safety of pedestrians and vehicles, to protect neighbours' living conditions, to maintain traffic flow, and to support sustainable transport objectives; in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1 & EC2.
Condition : 8 - Site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers or direct light into any neighbouring windows in accordance with the guidance provided by the Institute of Lighting Engineers Guidance Note: For The Reduction Of Obtrusive Light 2021.

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and in the interests of highway safety
